N次元将棋 — Third-party notices / 第三者の素材と条件
==================================================

1. Poly Haven textures (CC0-1.0)
   Wood Table 001, American Walnut Veneer, Sandstone Cracks — https://polyhaven.com/
   CC0-1.0 / public domain. Sources and checksums: Notices/PolyHaven/NOTICE.txt and provenance.json.
   盤・机・庭の石のテクスチャは Poly Haven の CC0 素材を加工したものです。

2. Piece name images / 駒名の文字画像
   The piece name images were drawn with Yu Mincho, a font bundled with Windows.
   They may be used only as part of this game; reusing them on their own as standalone images is not permitted.
   No font file is redistributed.
   駒名の画像は Windows 付属の游明朝で描いた文字画像です。このゲームの一部としてのみ使用でき、
   画像を単独の素材として再利用することはできません。フォントファイルは同梱していません。

3. Unity
   Built with Unity 6000.3 and the High Definition Render Pipeline. The Unity runtime (UnityPlayer.dll,
   the files under NDShogi_Data, MonoBleedingEdge and D3D12) is governed by the Unity terms:
   https://unity.com/legal/terms-of-service
   Unity Companion License for Unity packages: https://unity.com/legal/licenses/unity-companion-license

4. Mono runtime (MonoBleedingEdge)
   Mono is distributed under the MIT License (with parts under other open source licenses):
   https://github.com/mono/mono/blob/main/LICENSE

The rest of this game (code, procedurally generated board, pieces, garden, sound effects and music
synthesized by tools/synth_audio.py) is under the MIT License in LICENSE.txt.
